Demo 05: Auto Scanner

ทดสอบ highlightAll() สแกน DOM อัตโนมัติ — รองรับทุกรูปแบบ: class, data-lang, h-lang, .hideko

Pattern 1: <pre><code class="language-javascript"> 
const greeting = "Hello World";
console.log(greeting);
Pattern 2: <pre class="language-python"> 
def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

print(greet("Hideko"))
Pattern 3: <div data-lang="sql">
SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE active = true ORDER BY created_at DESC;
Pattern 4: <div h-lang="css">
.button { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; color: white; cursor: pointer; }
Pattern 5: <code class="lang-go"> (prefix lang-) 
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    fmt.Println("Hello from Go!")
}
Pattern 6: <div class="hideko" data-lang="json">
{ "name": "hideko", "version": "1.0.0", "fast": true, "size_kb": 14.08 }
